# teams_client_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing ClientConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allow_box` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBox parameter.
- `allow_drop_box` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowDropBox parameter.
- `allow_egnyte` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowEgnyte parameter.
- `allow_email_into_channel` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowEmailIntoChannel parameter.
- `allow_google_drive` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowGoogleDrive parameter.
- `allow_guest_user` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowGuestUser parameter.
- `allow_organization_tab` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowOrganizationTab parameter.
- `allow_resource_account_send_message` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowResourceAccountSendMessage parameter.
- `allow_role_based_chat_permissions` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowRoleBasedChatPermissions parameter.
- `allow_scoped_people_searchand_access` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowScopedPeopleSearchandAccess parameter.
- `allow_share_file` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowShareFile parameter.
- `allow_skype_business_interop` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowSkypeBusinessInterop parameter.
- `content_pin` (String) Maps to the -ContentPin parameter.
- `extended_work_info_in_people_search` (Boolean) Maps to the -ExtendedWorkInfoInPeopleSearch parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `resource_account_content_access` (String) Maps to the -ResourceAccountContentAccess parameter.
- `restricted_sender_list` (String) Maps to the -RestrictedSenderList parameter.
- `use_unified_domain` (String) Maps to the -UseUnifiedDomain parameter.
